_meta.purpose: Reference labels for the UM evidence mapping prototype. Task 1.1 of BUILD_SEQUENCE.md.
_meta.authoring_rule: These labels were written BEFORE any clinical document existed, per Spec Section 6 and BUILD_SEQUENCE Task 1.1. Task 1.2 writes packets that embody exactly this truth. Task 1.3 reads each packet against its label; where the label cannot be determined from the documents alone, one of the two is wrong and is fixed before the test split is locked.
_meta.synthetic_notice: SYNTHETIC DEMONSTRATION CASES against SYNTHETIC DEMONSTRATION CRITERIA. Not Humana coverage policies. No real or de-identified patient data.
_meta.split_note: All variants derived from a case remain in the parent case's split.
_meta.split_size_change: The original allocation was 12 development, 8 held-out, 5 transfer, and held-out was exactly 48 criterion instances, which is the figure Spec Section 9's adoption threshold was written against. On 2026-09-09 three cases were added, taking development to 15 and held-out to 9. The reason was measurement, not scenario coverage: six of twelve criteria had a majority-class baseline at or above 70 percent and lumbar_mri C1 was MET in every case, meaning a system could score well on them without reading, and four statuses occurred in exactly one case each, which made every unique feature of that case a perfect predictor. The 12/8/5 figures were a starting allocation rather than a property worth protecting at the cost of the experiment's power. Held-out is now 55 instances of which 53 are scorable; see held_out_denominator_caveat.
_meta.every_criterion_labeled: Each case carries an expectation for every criterion in its procedure's set. There are no unlabeled criterion instances.

label_semantics.clinical_status: What the submitted documents will support under the synthetic criterion. MET, NOT_MET, or AMBIGUOUS. Reference labels never carry null; null is a pipeline outcome meaning no valid clinical result was produced, not a property of a document set.
label_semantics.processing_status: Not labeled here. Every case in this corpus is expected to process to COMPLETE. PARTIAL and FAILED are produced by the deterministic fault-injection controls in Task 3.4, not by corpus content.
label_semantics.reason_codes: Empty for a clean MET or NOT_MET. Reference labels use only MISSING_EVIDENCE, CONFLICTING_EVIDENCE, VAGUE_DURATION, and INSUFFICIENT_CONTEXT. UNVERIFIABLE_QUOTE, UNSUPPORTED_CONCLUSION, and PROCESSING_ERROR describe pipeline runtime behavior and can never be properties of a document set.
label_semantics.evidence_units_required: Count of distinct reference evidence units that must be recovered for the criterion instance to score as recovered. Zero where the fact is genuinely absent from the packet and there is nothing to cite.
label_semantics.evidence_requirement: ALTERNATIVE: any one listed acceptable passage counts as recovered. COMPOSITE: all required units must be recovered. NONE: no units exist. Marked before scoring per Spec Section 9 equivalent-evidence scoring.
label_semantics.evidence_note: What the packet must contain for this label to hold. Task 1.2 writes to this. Never written into the documents as an annotation.
label_semantics.waived_by_exception: Present where a criteria-set exception pathway makes this criterion non-required for the case. The clinical_status still reports what the record supports; the waiver is separate.

not_met_bar.rule: Spec Section 4 and CLAUDE.md. NOT_MET is used only where the label states why the evidence is affirmatively contradictory, that the record is complete on that point, and that no exception applies. A near-threshold shortfall alone is AMBIGUOUS. Missing evidence is never NOT_MET.
not_met_bar.encoded_as: Every NOT_MET instance carries a not_met_justification object with all three fields populated. A NOT_MET without all three is a defective label.
not_met_bar.count: 12 of 189 criterion instances, 6.3 percent. Was 9 of 165 at Task 1.1. TKA-001 C3 and TKA-104 C4 were both downgraded on review; five were added with the baseline-breaking cases.
not_met_bar.what_clears_the_bar: The eight that survive are all first-hand and contemporaneous: a clinician's own examination, a primary document present in the packet, or an enumerated disposition recorded at the time. A categorical statement about what did not happen, taken as history from a patient at one encounter, does not clear it. That distinction was not explicit when the labels were authored and cost one NOT_MET on review.
deliberate_contrasts: TKA-001 C3 is NOT_MET on a 6-week documented span against a 3-month threshold because the referral explicitly states no conservative treatment preceded it. TKA-101 C3 is AMBIGUOUS on a 10-week span against the same threshold because outside therapy records are referenced but not included. The shortfall is similar; the completeness of the record is not.

MRI-101 C5 and MRI-006 C5 are NOT_MET on affirmative prior-imaging evidence plus an explicit no-interval-change statement. MRI-002 C5 and MRI-104 C5 are AMBIGUOUS with MISSING_EVIDENCE because prior imaging is simply never addressed. Same criterion, opposite handling of absence.

LF-202 C4 is NOT_MET because physical therapy is mandatory for that criterion and the record affirmatively documents declination, while the fusion exception pathway waives only the C3 duration requirement and therefore does not reach C4.

reason_code_rule.why_this_exists: MISSING_EVIDENCE and INSUFFICIENT_CONTEXT together account for most AMBIGUOUS instances. Without a written boundary, document generation in Task 1.2 drifts and the reference becomes internally inconsistent.
reason_code_rule.decision_test: Ask: is there a passage in the packet a reviewer would point at when explaining why this criterion is unresolved? If no, the code is MISSING_EVIDENCE and evidence_units_required is 0. If yes, the code is one of the other three and at least one unit is required.
reason_code_rule.MISSING_EVIDENCE: Nothing in the packet addresses the criterion. There is no passage to cite. Always 0 units and evidence_requirement NONE. This is the code for genuine absence, and it is never NOT_MET.
reason_code_rule.INSUFFICIENT_CONTEXT: Something in the packet addresses the criterion but lacks what is needed to interpret it. The passage exists and must be cited. Covers four recurring shapes: a value below threshold where completeness is not established (TKA-101 C3), a symptom documented without the specificity the criterion demands (TKA-002 C2), a composite where one component is documented and another is not established (TKA-001 C4, LF-203 C4), and a compound exclusion where one limb is addressed and the other is open (LF-202 C9).
reason_code_rule.VAGUE_DURATION: Reserved for duration criteria where a span is asserted without dates or any countable quantity. The assertion itself is the citable unit. If a duration is stated numerically but falls short or is hedged, that is INSUFFICIENT_CONTEXT, not VAGUE_DURATION. Compare TKA-005 C3, a long course, which is VAGUE_DURATION, against MRI-006 C2, approximately 5 weeks, which is INSUFFICIENT_CONTEXT.
reason_code_rule.CONFLICTING_EVIDENCE: Two or more passages make incompatible claims about the same criterion. Always at least 2 units, since a contradiction cannot be represented by one side.
reason_code_rule.precedence: Where more than one could apply, use the first that matches: CONFLICTING_EVIDENCE, then VAGUE_DURATION, then INSUFFICIENT_CONTEXT, then MISSING_EVIDENCE. Exactly one reason code per AMBIGUOUS instance in this reference.
enforced_invariants: MISSING_EVIDENCE if and only if evidence_units_required is 0. Checked in both directions.
MET and NOT_MET carry an empty reason_codes list.
Reference labels never use UNVERIFIABLE_QUOTE, UNSUPPORTED_CONCLUSION, or PROCESSING_ERROR.

evidence_unit_rule.why_this_exists: Evidence recall is scored against these counts. A wrong count produces a wrong recall figure that looks plausible and is not detectable at scoring time.
evidence_unit_rule.set_default_versus_instance: criteria_sets.json declares an evidence_requirement per criterion. That is the default shape of the criterion, not the shape of every instance. The value on each instance here governs scoring and may legitimately diverge.
evidence_unit_rule.divergence_is_expected: A set-level COMPOSITE criterion becomes an instance-level ALTERNATIVE when the packet happens to satisfy it in a single passage. MRI C2 is COMPOSITE by default because duration usually needs two dated encounters, but MRI-001 states 10 weeks outright, so that instance is 1 unit ALTERNATIVE. Conversely a set-level ALTERNATIVE criterion becomes instance-level COMPOSITE whenever the packet makes it a contradiction, a progression across two timepoints, or a documented complete negative.
counting_rules: Explicitly stated span satisfying a duration criterion: 1 unit, ALTERNATIVE.
Span that must be derived from two dated passages: 2 units, COMPOSITE.
Contradiction: 1 unit per side, minimum 2, COMPOSITE.
Progression across timepoints: 1 unit per timepoint, minimum 2, COMPOSITE.
Count-based composite such as at least two modalities: 1 unit per passage needed to establish or refute the count.
Compound exclusion such as lumbar_fusion C9: 1 unit per limb the packet actually addresses. LF-204 C9 addresses both limbs and carries 2 units; LF-202 C9 addresses only infection and carries 1.
Nothing addresses the criterion: 0 units, NONE.
evidence_unit_rule.audit: All 7 set-level COMPOSITE criteria are populated across all instances, verified programmatically. Instance requirement is consistent with unit count in every case: 0 units maps to NONE, 1 to ALTERNATIVE, 2 or more to COMPOSITE.

independence.held_out_test: 8 cases but 7 independent observations. TKA-103V is derived from TKA-103 and differs only in verbosity, so the pair contributes one independent clinical observation, not two. Spec Section 9's adoption threshold reasons over approximately 48 criterion instances across 8 cases; the instance count is exact at 48, but the effective independent case count is 7 and the effective independent criterion count is 41.
independence.development: 12 cases, 11 independent observations. TKA-005V is derived from TKA-005.
independence.transfer: 5 cases, 5 independent observations. No derived variants, which is why no density pair was added there.
independence.reporting_requirement: State the independent counts alongside the raw counts whenever held-out results are reported, in the same place the transfer density gap is disclosed. Density pairs are reported as a paired within-case comparison and are not treated as two independent samples in any aggregate.
independence.effect_on_threshold: The adoption threshold is unchanged, since it is defined over criterion instances and the instance denominator is unaffected. What changes is the confidence attachable to a case-level difference driven by a density pair, since a difference appearing in both TKA-103 and TKA-103V is one finding observed twice, not two findings.

measurable_error_directions.note: Recorded before any run so the limitation cannot be discovered after results are seen.
measurable_error_directions.reference_MET_output_as_NOT_MET: Denominator 79 across the corpus, 23 in held-out. Measurable. This is the incorrect mismatch rate in Spec Section 9 and is the error direction the corpus is built to detect.
measurable_error_directions.reference_NOT_MET_output_as_MET: Denominator 9 across the corpus, 3 in held-out. Not measurable at this sample size. Report raw counts and name the affected criterion instances. Do not compute or present a rate, and do not describe zero observed failures as evidence of safety.
measurable_error_directions.why_not_inflated: The obvious fix would be to add NOT_MET instances until the denominator supports a rate. That would require relaxing the bar in Spec Section 4, which is the constraint the prototype exists to demonstrate. The bar is correct, so the measurement limit is accepted and disclosed instead.
measurable_error_directions.further_caveat: Two of those three are the density pair, so held-out carries 2 independent reference NOT_MET observations, not 3. The direction is effectively unmeasured rather than merely underpowered.

evidence_interpretation.why_this_exists: Spec Section 13 item 2 requires the demonstration to show evidence that needs semantic interpretation. Evidence placed in an unexpected section is positional and does not satisfy that requirement on its own. The distinction is recorded per instance so document generation cannot erase it.

values.direct: Stated where a reviewer would look, in the criterion's own vocabulary. The default. Not annotated on instances.
values.positional: Criterion vocabulary is present or near-verbatim, but the passage sits somewhere unexpected. Tests retrieval across a packet, not interpretation.
values.derived: No single passage states the fact. It must be computed, usually a span between two dated passages. Tests reasoning, not vocabulary.
values.semantic: The criterion's vocabulary never appears. Satisfying it requires mapping clinical content onto the requirement, such as recognising meloxicam as an NSAID. Each semantic instance carries a lexical_constraint naming the words that must not appear in the generated document.

evidence_interpretation.audit_of_buried_cases: Of the 5 cases tagged buried_evidence: MRI-005, TKA-004, and MRI-101 contain genuinely semantic instances. LF-201 and LF-202 are positional only, and their C7 instances are annotated to say so, since never smoker and cessation both match the criterion wording almost verbatim.

load_bearing_count.finding: The corpus contains ONE load-bearing semantic instance, not four. MRI-005 C3 is the only one where the criterion cannot be satisfied without the semantic step. Established by the Task 1.3 manual check on 2026-09-09.
load_bearing_count.MRI-005 C3: Load-bearing. The only conservative management evidence in the packet is a medication reconciliation line naming meloxicam with a trial outcome. No clinical note names the drug or the outcome. Nothing satisfies the criterion unless the reader knows meloxicam is an NSAID, which the packet never states.
load_bearing_count.TKA-004 C2: NOT load-bearing. The physical therapy subjective reads pain with stairs and with prolonged standing, and the criterion's own satisfied_by names difficulty with stairs. The dog-walking goal is never required. The discharge summary restates the goal as well.
load_bearing_count.TKA-004 C4: NOT load-bearing. The criterion needs two of five modalities. Physical therapy and an intra-articular injection are both plainly documented, so the count is reached without ever reading the nutrition note as a weight reduction modality. The semantic passage is a third path, not a necessary one.
load_bearing_count.MRI-101 C3: Held out, not read during this check. Provisionally load-bearing, since the referral form's prior treatment field is the only conservative management evidence, but this must be confirmed when the held-out packets are written and checked.
load_bearing_count.consequence: Semantic interpretation is measurable on one criterion instance, in development only. It is not measurable in held-out or transfer. No claim about semantic performance can rest on more than this single instance, and a single instance cannot support a rate. Report it by name, as an existence demonstration, never as a proportion.
load_bearing_count.why_not_repaired: TKA-004 C2 and C4 were left as written. Removing the easier paths would mean deleting a physical therapy subjective line that any real evaluation would contain, and dropping one of two plainly documented modalities from a criterion that asks for two. Both edits would make the packet tidier than a real one, which Spec Section 14 and CLAUDE.md both forbid. The instances remain genuine semantic content; they are simply not the only route to the answer.

evidence_interpretation.demonstration_candidate: MRI-005 C3 is the sole primary instance for the Spec Section 13 item 2 demonstration. The medication line names meloxicam and records a trial outcome; that meloxicam is an NSAID is a fact about the world the document never states. A documented keyword query for NSAID returns nothing against the packet, so the contrast is visible without any claim about keyword search in general, and it is legible to an audience with no clinical background. There is no backup. TKA-004 C2 was previously named as one and has been withdrawn: the Task 1.3 check found that the physical therapy subjective independently satisfies the criterion, so it is not a semantic instance in the sense the demonstration requires. Demonstrating on it would show the system finding evidence it could have found lexically. See load_bearing_count.
evidence_interpretation.task_1_2_obligation: lexical_constraint is a hard constraint on document generation, not a hint. Task 1.3 verifies each constraint by searching the generated packet for the prohibited terms. A packet that contains them has destroyed the instance and must be rewritten.
evidence_interpretation.gap: Transfer has no semantic instance. Its buried evidence is positional. Semantic interpretation results are therefore reported for MRI and knee only, and no claim is made about semantic performance on an unfamiliar procedure.

scenario_tags.buried_evidence: The satisfying passage exists but is not where a reviewer would look first.
scenario_tags.unrelated_section: Evidence sits in a section unrelated to the requirement, such as social history, a medication reconciliation list, or a scheduling note.
scenario_tags.semantic_interpretation: Carries at least one instance where the criterion's vocabulary never appears and the evidence must be mapped onto the requirement. Distinct from buried_evidence, which is positional. Required for the Spec Section 13 item 2 demonstration.
scenario_tags.derived_evidence: Carries at least one instance where no passage states the fact and it must be computed, usually a span between two dated passages.
scenario_tags.superseded_impression: A document's initial impression is wrong or incomplete for the criterion, and the satisfying finding sits in an addendum or amendment below the signature. Tests whether the system reads a whole document or stops at the impression line. Tagged so that a failure on such an instance is attributable in the scenario breakdown rather than appearing as an unexplained miss.
scenario_tags.vague_duration: Duration asserted without dates or a countable span.
scenario_tags.near_threshold_duration: A documented span close to the criterion threshold, on either side.
scenario_tags.contradiction: Two passages in the packet make incompatible claims about the same requirement.
scenario_tags.copy_forward: Stale text carried forward into a later note, contradicting same-day findings.
scenario_tags.silent_absence: One or more requirements are never addressed anywhere in the packet.
scenario_tags.density_pair: Two cases carrying identical clinical facts at different verbosity. Robustness testing with equity implications, not evidence of demographic fairness, per Spec Section 6.
scenario_tags.concise_variant: The terse member of a density pair.
scenario_tags.verbose_variant: The padded member of a density pair. Same facts, more clutter.
scenario_tags.cross_document_reasoning: The requirement can only be resolved by combining passages from two or more documents.
scenario_tags.composite_logic_trap: The criterion requires a specific combination, and a plausible near-miss combination is present.
scenario_tags.near_miss_diagnosis: A related but non-qualifying diagnosis is documented in place of a qualifying one.
scenario_tags.affirmative_contradiction: The packet contains evidence that affirmatively conflicts with a requirement. Present on every case carrying a NOT_MET.
scenario_tags.affirmative_negative_exclusion: A complete documented negative, such as a full red-flag review of systems, rather than an absence of mention.
scenario_tags.exception_pathway: A criteria-set exception is triggered, changing which criteria are required.
scenario_tags.prior_imaging_conflict: Recent prior imaging is documented alongside a statement of no interval clinical change.
scenario_tags.incomplete_outside_records: The packet references records held elsewhere that are not included, so the record is not complete on that point.
scenario_tags.secondhand_history: A categorical clinical statement about what did or did not happen rests on a history taken from the patient at one encounter, with no primary or outside records to corroborate it. It sounds authoritative and reads like completeness, but it establishes only what the clinician was told. Distinguishes a documented fact from a documented account of a fact.
scenario_tags.near_miss_modality: A treatment is documented with a genuine outcome but falls outside the modalities the criterion lists, so it is real evidence of care that does not satisfy the requirement. Resolves to AMBIGUOUS with INSUFFICIENT_CONTEXT rather than MISSING_EVIDENCE, because a reviewer would cite it when explaining why the criterion is unresolved.
scenario_tags.baseline_breaker: The case exists primarily to lower a majority-class baseline or to supply a second instance of a status that occurred only once. Its purpose is measurement rather than scenario coverage. A criterion whose every case shares an answer cannot discriminate one configuration from another, and a status occurring in exactly one case makes every unique feature of that case a perfect predictor of it.
scenario_tags.structured_form_completeness: Completeness for a NOT_MET is established by automated extracts whose coverage answers the question, rather than by any clinician stating that the record is complete.
scenario_tags.apparent_completeness_trap: The packet contains a document that looks capable of establishing completeness and is honest about its own limits, and those limits are what defeat it. A pharmacy dispensing history that excludes counter sales cannot close a question about over-the-counter medication. Tagged so that a NOT_MET returned here is attributable to over-reading an authoritative-looking document rather than to a generic absence error.
scenario_tags.mixed_date_convention: The packet contains documents from institutions using different date conventions, one MM/DD and one DD/MM, as transferred records genuinely do. Retained deliberately as realistic clutter, and verified not to be load-bearing: no criterion in the case derives its answer from date arithmetic. Tagged so that a date-related failure is attributable rather than unexplained. Where mixing was within a single document, or between two departments of one institution, it was an authoring error and was corrected.
scenario_tags.administrative_date_inference: The packet contains a dated administrative event, such as a referral being lodged or an authorization denied, from which a reader could infer a clinical timeline the record never documents. The dated event is not evidence of a symptom or a treatment, and a duration derived from it is not supported. Tagged so a duration or duration-adjacent failure on such a case is attributable rather than unexplained.
scenario_tags.nothing_prescribed_trap: The packet affirmatively records that nothing was prescribed or given at a particular visit. This is not evidence that a treatment was never attempted, but its affirmative phrasing invites conversion of absence into NOT_MET. Tagged so a failure of that kind is attributable.
scenario_tags.generic_symptom_trap: A symptom is documented without the specificity the criterion requires.
scenario_tags.clean_baseline: A well-documented packet with few traps. Included to test precision, not recall.
scenario_tags.explicit_duration: Duration stated plainly with a countable span.

known_gaps: The density pair scenario appears in development (TKA-005 / TKA-005V) and held-out (TKA-103 / TKA-103V) but not in transfer. Adding a pair to a 5-case split would leave only 4 independent transfer cases, and Spec Section 6 already holds that variants derived from one case are not independent observations. Density results are therefore reported for MRI and knee only.

The held-out split has 8 cases but 7 independent observations, because TKA-103V is derived from TKA-103. Spec Section 9's threshold reasoning assumes 8 cases. The criterion-instance denominator is unaffected and remains exactly 48. See _meta.independence, and state the independent counts wherever held-out results are reported.

The critical error direction reference NOT_MET output as MET has a denominator of 3 in held-out, and only 2 of those are independent. It is not measurable at this sample size. Report raw counts and name the affected instances; do not compute a rate. See _meta.measurable_error_directions. The NOT_MET bar was not relaxed to fix this, because the bar is the constraint the prototype exists to demonstrate.

Transfer contains no semantic-interpretation instance; its buried evidence is positional only. Semantic results are reported for MRI and knee only, with no claim about semantic performance on an unfamiliar procedure. See _meta.evidence_interpretation.gap.
Reference labels come from a single labeler. No inter-rater agreement is measured, per Spec Section 15.
Scenario tag counts are small. Per-tag results are exploratory, not comparative.

scorable_instances.note: NOT_APPLICABLE instances are waived by an exception pathway and are excluded from evidence recall, evidence precision, and status performance denominators. Scorable counts are what metrics divide by.

distribution_at_authoring.held_out_denominator_caveat: Spec Section 9 states the adoption threshold over approximately 48 criterion instances across 8 held-out cases. That is now out of date in two ways. MRI-103 C2 and C3 became NOT_APPLICABLE and are excluded from every denominator, and TKA-104 was added. Held-out now holds 9 cases and 55 criterion instances, of which 53 are scorable. The adoption threshold itself is unchanged and its 10 percentage point margin still corresponds to roughly 5 instances at this size. Report 53 as the denominator. The change enlarges the test rather than shrinking it, so the threshold is if anything slightly more conservative than when it was written.
distribution_at_authoring.revised_by_task_1_3: Two revisions. TKA-001 C3 was downgraded from NOT_MET to AMBIGUOUS because a consultant's intake history does not establish record completeness, taking corpus NOT_MET from 9 to 8. Then five waived instances moved from AMBIGUOUS to NOT_APPLICABLE under the waiver rule added in criteria set 1.1.0. Held-out reference NOT_MET is unchanged at 3 and remains unmeasurable as a rate.
